kpis.description_fr: 3,3 M clients gaz dans 6 États (IN, OH, PA, VA, KY, MD). Plus gros producteur gaz naturel régulé par # de clients USA.
kpis.description_en: 3.3M gas customers in 6 states (IN, OH, PA, VA, KY, MD). Largest regulated natural gas distributor by customers in USA.

kpis.description_fr: ~500k clients électricité via NIPSCO (Indiana). Plan transition gas→renewable + nuclear. SMR studied.
kpis.description_en: ~500k electric customers via NIPSCO (Indiana). Gas→renewable + nuclear transition plan. SMR studied.

kpis.description_fr: ~19 Mds $ capex 2024-2029 = grid modernization + gas safety + clean energy. Rate base growth ~9 % /an.
kpis.description_en: ~$19B capex 2024-2029 = grid modernization + gas safety + clean energy. ~9% rate base growth/year.

kpis.description_fr: Plan retraite 100 % charbon NIPSCO d'ici 2028. Remplacement par renewables (solaire/wind) + gas + storage. Trajectoire ESG forte.
kpis.description_en: Plan to retire 100% NIPSCO coal by 2028. Replaced by renewables (solar/wind) + gas + storage. Strong ESG trajectory.

kpis.description_fr: Rate base growth ~9 % /an = parmi les plus hauts utilities USA. Capex flow → earnings flow régulé.
kpis.description_en: Rate base growth ~9%/year = among highest US utilities. Capex flow → regulated earnings flow.
